properties.name: --we-radius
properties.description: Corner radius of the frame, output panel, inline card and floating panels

properties.name: --we-gap
properties.description: Gap between the editor and the live output in split view

properties.name: --we-min-height
properties.description: Minimum height of the editor frame and body

properties.name: --we-font-family
properties.description: Editor font

properties.name: --we-accent
properties.description: Accent: toggled commands (both toolbars), pending loader; --we-selected-outline-color follows it

properties.name: --we-text-on-accent
properties.description: Text on the accent fill (toggled commands) — black or white, whichever reads better

properties.name: --we-text-color
properties.description: Body text

properties.name: --we-muted-fg
properties.description: Muted text: status bar, empty-document placeholder

properties.name: --we-bg
properties.description: Editing surface and output panel background; the derived surfaces follow it

properties.name: --we-muted-bg
properties.description: Raised strips: zone toolbar, status bar, output tabs, table headers, preview surface

properties.name: --we-hover-bg
properties.description: Hover overlay of toolbar commands and output tabs

properties.name: --we-border
properties.description: Frame, dividers, group separators, table cell borders, image hover outline

properties.name: --we-danger
properties.description: Destructive commands

properties.name: --we-shadow-color
properties.description: Shadow tone of the inline card and the floating panels

properties.name: --we-selection-toolbar-bg
properties.description: Selection-toolbar pill background — a dark pill in both modes (tooltip tokens)

properties.name: --we-selection-toolbar-color
properties.description: Selection-toolbar pill text; its hover and separator are mixes of it

properties.name: --we-tooltip-bg
properties.description: Toolbar button / status item tooltip background (core createTooltip; the shared tooltip tokens)

properties.name: --we-tooltip-color
properties.description: Toolbar button / status item tooltip text

properties.name: --we-tooltip-z-index
properties.description: Tooltip stacking (core Z_INDEX tooltip tier)

properties.name: --we-popover-z-index
properties.description: Stacking of the inline-mode card over the page and of the selection toolbar (core Z_INDEX popover tier)

properties.name: --we-link-color
properties.description: Links in the document

properties.name: --we-link-color-hover
properties.description: Hovered links

properties.name: --we-focus-outline
properties.description: Keyboard focus ring (:focus-visible) of toolbar / selection-toolbar buttons, output tabs, output panel

properties.name: --we-focus-outline-offset
properties.description: Offset of the focus ring outside a button / output tab; the output panel draws it inset by the same amount

properties.name: --we-selected-outline-color
properties.description: Outline of a selected node (image, …), selected-cell border, column-resize handle

properties.name: --we-selected-cell-bg
properties.description: Selected table cells

properties.name: --we-inline-code-bg
properties.description: Inline code background

properties.name: --we-inline-code-color
properties.description: Inline code text

properties.name: --we-code-block-bg
properties.description: Code block background — the same in both modes on purpose (Prism's dark "tomorrow" highlighting)

properties.name: --we-code-block-color
properties.description: Code block text — the same in both modes on purpose

properties.name: --we-code-block-label-color
properties.description: Code block language label — the same in both modes on purpose

properties.name: --we-code-toolbar-label-color
properties.description: Code toolbar label — the same in both modes on purpose

properties.name: --we-disabled-opacity
properties.description: Fade of disabled toolbar / selection-toolbar commands

properties.name: --we-loader-icon
properties.description: Pending loader glyph (a mask tinted by the accent)

properties.name: --we-loader-rotate
properties.description: Pending loader rotation per cycle (0 for a self-animating SVG)

properties.name: --we-loader-duration
properties.description: Pending loader spin duration

properties.name: --we-loader-size
properties.description: Pending loader size
